human.problem: The text is a prophecy in the future tense: "will overflow," "will wail," "will not turn back," "will be silenced." Several cards retell it in the present tense as if it is happening now. Card 7 says "the Philistine fathers turn back," card 10 says Tyre and Sidon "get cut off," and card 13 says "Ashkelon goes quiet." Card 12, in contrast, keeps "will be silenced." Storyteller present tense may blur what was foretold with what took place.
human.question: In prophetic passages, may Papa Dorin retell the foretold events in storyteller present tense, or must cards keep the prophecy's future tense ("will") so they don't present a prediction as an event already happening?
